record.paper_title: Selection Principles and Special Sets of Reals
record.original_question: Let B denote the family of countable Borel covers of a set of reals. Borel’s Conjecture for a class J means that every member of J is countable. Is it consistent that every set of reals satisfying Sfin(B, B) is countable?

evidence.quote: Is Borel’s Conjecture for Sfin(B, B) consistent?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a set of reals $X$, let $\mathcal{B}(X)$ denote the family of countable covers of $X$ by Borel subsets of $\mathbb{R}$. The selection principle $\mathsf{S}_{\mathrm{fin}}(\mathcal{B},\mathcal{B})$ asserts that for every sequence $(\mathcal{U}_n)_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$ with each $\mathcal{U}_n\in\mathcal{B}(X)$, there exist finite subfamilies $\mathcal{F}_n\subseteq \mathcal{U}_n$ such that $\bigcup_{n\in\mathbb{N}}\mathcal{F}_n$ is a cover of $X$ (this is the Menger-type selection principle restricted to countable Borel covers).

For a class $\mathcal{J}$ of sets of reals, "Borel's Conjecture for $\mathcal{J}$" is the statement that every member of $\mathcal{J}$ is countable.

Question: Is it consistent with ZFC that every set of reals $X\subseteq\mathbb{R}$ satisfying $\mathsf{S}_{\mathrm{fin}}(\mathcal{B},\mathcal{B})$ is countable?
artifact.status_search_result: Searches in the selection-principles literature (surveys by Tsaban, Scheepers, Miller, and the 2020 Centenary of the Borel Conjecture volume) reveal active work on Borel-style conjectures for Menger and Hurewicz-type classes, but no clear announcement of a consistency proof or refutation specifically for the Menger-type Borel selection principle $\mathsf{S}_{\mathrm{fin}}(\mathcal{B},\mathcal{B})$. The status could not be definitively verified from available sources.

status_evidence.snippet: Volume devoted to recent developments on the Borel Conjecture and its variants.

status_evidence.title: The γ-Borel conjecture (A. Miller)
status_evidence.snippet: Proves consistency of the Borel conjecture restricted to γ-sets.
status_evidence.claim: Borel-Conjecture variants for restricted selection-principle classes have been resolved for γ-sets but analogous results for Menger-type Borel covers are not given here.
